description: This file defines utility functions for processing voice wake commands, including trimming, normalizing, and detecting trigger phrases in transcripts.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a string token by trimming whitespace and punctuation, then converting to lowercase.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if the transcript starts with any of the provided trigger phrases by comparing normalized tokens.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Determines if the transcript contains a specific command initiated by triggers, after validation and trimming.
